buildSentences.display: Students should prepare for exams by reviewing material.

Reading books is essential for developing critical thinking.

Traveling can broaden a person's perspective on life.
Effective communication skills are important in the workplace.
Technology has changed the way we learn and interact.
Volunteering provides opportunities to help others and gain skills.
